title.en: Pingat Jasa Berani (The Medal of Bravery) Rules 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 10 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules are the Pingat Jasa Berani (The Medal of Bravery) Rules 2025 and come into operation on 9 August 2025.
3. The Medal is designated and styled the Pingat Jasa Berani (the Medal of Bravery).
4. The Medal may be awarded to any person for acts of exemplary bravery in hazardous circumstances.

5.—(1) The Medal is silver-gilt.
(2) The obverse side of the Medal features —
(a)a diagonal Maltese cross combined with a four‑pointed star, arranged in a compass rose design superimposed on 2 crossed swords;
(b)in its centre, a shield bearing a crescent and 5 stars positioned over another pair of crossed swords; and
(c)at the base, a scroll bearing the words “PINGAT JASA BERANI”.
(3) The reverse side of the Medal features the National Coat of Arms.
(4) The Medal has the design set out in the Schedule.

6.—(1) The Medal is to be worn on the left side of the outer garment suspended by a ribbon.
(2) The ribbon is white with a red edging and a purple centre band.

7.—(1) Where an act deserving of the award of the Medal is performed by a person to whom the Medal has already been awarded, the act may be recognised by the award of a Bar to the Medal.
(2) The Bar is silver-gilt and attached to the ribbon by which the Medal is suspended.
(3) There is no limit to the number of Bars that may be awarded to a holder of the Medal.
(4) For each Bar awarded, a small star in silver-gilt may be added to the ribbon when worn alone.

heading.en: Publication and register of persons awarded Medal or Bar

text.en: 8. The names of the persons to whom the Medal or a Bar is awarded must be published in the Gazette and a register of those names must be kept in the office of the Prime Minister.
9. The President may forfeit any Medal and Bar (if any) awarded to any person under these Rules if the person is convicted of a criminal offence or is guilty of misconduct or disloyalty to Singapore.
